messages:
mira: Nightly eval alerted on longprefix_cohort — 18% blank/early-truncate vs baseline 0.5%. Attached samples show prefix disappearing mid-response. Initial severity P2. anyone able to take?

eval-bot: nightly-eval artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/evals/1754321987 (samples + logs + traces)

samir: I'll pick this up. quick glance: many 'blank output' samples look like KV cache misses after eviction. pinging @kai for runtime logs/traces.

kai: on it. pulling node logs now. early sign: repeated lines `kvcache: evict prefix id=` across canary nodes. saw a batch_size bump to 16 in the canary config last night.

mira: model + env? is this the int4 roll?

samir: model: /models/redwood-7b-v2-int4; env: staging-int4-canary-3. config snapshot:
```
batch_size: 16
kv_cache_capacity: 1024
kv_eviction_policy: lru
```

kai: correlating timestamps: eviction storms start at 02:14 UTC, right when we had a small burst ~120 concurrent requests. eviction logs show same prefix ids repeatedly evicted then reinserted. looks like churn.

lisa: i repro locally with a small script that sends 3 overlapping long-context requests — one run returns truncated prefix then a blank continuation. will paste repro steps shortly. cc @ops-bot for infra metrics.

ops-bot: infra metrics: GPU mem spike and a few tiny OOMs at 02:15, autoscaler removed pod-34 (canary) at 02:16. pod restart coincides with the worst of the blanks.

samir: hypothesis: batch_size * kv_entry growth + LRU eviction + prefix reordering leads to active prefixes being evicted mid-flight. when evicted, model loses KV context -> truncated/blank output. not seeing immediate model arithmetic errors, more a cache lifecycle issue.

mira: makes sense. what are mitigation options?

kai: mitigation until fix: reduce canary batch_size to 8 and bump kv_cache_capacity to 2048 (or set a temporary pin so autoscaler doesn't churn canary pods). also consider locking recently-used prefixes for N tokens to avoid LRU evicting active contexts.

samir: I'll open runtime bug and propose a soft-guard: mark prefixes active for last 512 tokens as non-evictable for a short period. assigning to samir + kai. ETA: quick patch in 1 business day for canary, longer design later.

lisa: eval action: re-run nightly on both stable and canary after canary config change to confirm drop is gone. will also re-run across quant variants to rule out quant-specific behavior.

mira: immediate action plan:
- samir/kai: create runtime issue + patch plan, implement temp guard + config change on canary (owner: samir)
- ops: apply batch_size=8 + kv_cache_capacity=2048 to staging-int4-canary-3 and hold autoscaler (owner: ops-bot / ops)
- eval: re-run nightly cohort for longprefix and upload artifacts (owner: lisa)

samir: created runtime issue: RUNTIME-1289 "prefix eviction storm under high batch_size". added trace id=evict-1754321987, attaching stack / flame traces.

kai: attached kvcache heatmap and flame: https://traces.redwood/evict-1754321987. early note: GC loop triggered by repeated allocations from batching path.

ops-bot: applied temporary config to staging-int4-canary-3: batch_size=8, kv_cache_capacity=2048, autoscaler panics disabled. rolling restart initiated.

lisa: queued eval re-run now. will ping when finished.

mira: lowering noise severity but leaving P2 open until we confirm next run. thanks for fast triage.

samir: will track fix progress. tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for follow-up.

lisa: confirmed — small-scale re-run shows blank rate down to 0.6% on canary after config change. waiting for full nightly results.

mira: great. follow-up tomorrow AM to close or escalate. :thumbsup:
